comment: Repo copies that must stay identical to their ~/.claude masters. Cloud sessions run ONLY the repo copy, so drift is a silent capability gap. strip-self-skip drops the repo-only guard (the if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/<this hook>" ] ... fi that exits when the master exists, one-line or multi-line) and the '# Self-skip' comment directly above it before comparing. See stripSelfSkip in scripts/lib/cloud-parity.js.
